editorial.blurb: A lively spot in Chinatown serving up Vietnamese and Thai favorites with genuine warmth and speed, where a steaming bowl of pho or a perfectly balanced curry can feel like a real discovery.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pho or #2 with beef and brisket with extra hot sauce on the side—most reviewers rave about these dishes arriving in under 10 minutes, making it perfect for a quick, satisfying meal.
